title: GrocLM：基于大语言模型的电商杂货品类推荐
summary: GrocLM 是一个针对电商杂货品类推荐微调的语言模型。它采用两阶段 LoRA 训练策略编码周期性购买模式，并引入基于前缀树的约束解码机制以确保输出有效。在真实生产环境中，其购物车添加率相对提升 7.5%，展示了 LLM 在结构化推荐系统中的实用性和有效性。
summary_en: GROCLM is a fine-tuned language model for grocery category recommendation. It uses a two-stage LoRA training strategy to encode cyclical purchasing patterns and a trie-based constrained decoding mechanism. In a live production restocking task, it achieves a 7.5% relative improvement in cart-adds per impression, demonstrating the effectiveness of LLMs in structured recommendation systems.
